summary: The real DES Y3 mass maps are downloaded and checked against an independent reconstruction (KaRMMa). The simulated universes are being matched to the real map's noise and filtering before the network is trained, so there is no real S8 measurement yet. The maps in the site's viewers are still practice data until the real export lands.
notes: The full DES map correlates 0.87-0.89 with the KaRMMa reconstruction over the footprint, which confirms its coordinates and quality.
The released DES map is already smoothed: it carries essentially no information on scales smaller than about half a degree (multipole l around 400), so the summary statistics stop there.
Simulations must receive the same shape noise and the same filtering as the real map before training; otherwise S8 would come out biased with no error message.
